task: Inspect Search Console crawled-but-not-indexed and robots-blocked examples for unintended exclusions

scope.selection: Every English URL in the export plus the first two URLs in each non-English locale/route-type group (or all if fewer than two). This is a purposive sample, not a random estimate of all 7,308.
scope.reportDateCaveat: The UI says last updated Nov 15; exported example rows include Nov 16. Both observations are preserved without treating the whole report as a Nov 21 measurement.

findings.result: No unintended robots exclusions found among all 83 exported URLs.
findings.action: Retain current rules; do not validate these intentional blocks as a fixed defect.

findings.result: The crawled-not-indexed export is predominantly non-English.
findings.caveat: Applies to the 1,000 exported examples only.

findings.result: All 82 English examples resolve to HTTP 200 indexable canonical pages advertised in the live sitemap.
findings.action: These are remaining Google indexing omissions, with no present robots/noindex/canonical/sitemap exclusion found. The checks do not establish why Google has omitted them.

findings.result: Of 72 live non-English examples, 38 now say noindex, 32 are directly indexable, and two old slugs redirect to indexable replacements.
findings.action: Retain deliberate quality/demand/topic and parameterized-search indexing rules. Historical crawled-not-indexed labels do not describe current eligibility for every URL.

findings.result: No live sitemap URL or alternate-language link matched a robots exclusion.
Two detailed Google URL inspections showed missing user-declared canonicals in their historical crawl data, but both current Google live tests detect the correct self-canonical.
findings.action: Monitor subsequent Google crawl data for canonical recognition; no current canonical defect reproduced. No causal attribution for the historical missing values is established.

live.status: URL is available to Google; Page can be indexed

googleUrlInspections.action: Keep eligible; no indexing request was made in this audit.

live.status: Page cannot be indexed: Excluded by noindex tag

googleUrlInspections.action: Consistent with deliberate translation eligibility rules; do not request indexing without reviewing those rules.

limitations: Only Google's 1,000 provided crawled-not-indexed examples were exported; the other 6,308 are not individually diagnosed.
154 sample URLs were checked live, including every English example in the export; the remaining exported URLs were classified by locale and route only.
No guarantee of indexing follows from an indexable live result.
No production data, indexing policy, code, translations, deployment or Search Console validation/indexing-request state was changed.
